title: World map: smaller pins, friends with room to breathe
kaylee: The map's pins are a little smaller, every friend has room around it, and the moose, the pizza and the panda are redrawn.

pictures.title: Up close
pictures.caption: Moose: flat antlers with points, a longer face. Pizza: the whole slice shows. Panda: both ears show, shiny eyes.

pictures.title: On the iPad
pictures.caption: Circles are 10% smaller; they tap the same as before.
